title: Non-Invasive Positive Pressure Ventilation (Respiratory Assist Devices / BiPAP with Backup)
description: DME MAC coverage criteria for respiratory assist devices (RAD / non-invasive ventilation, HCPCS E0470, E0471). Requires documented daytime hypercapnia with arterial PaCO2 >= 52 mmHg (or nocturnal oximetry showing SpO2 <= 88% for >= 5 continuous minutes) in chronic severe COPD or neuromuscular restrictive disease.

criteria.name: Daytime Hypercapnia (Arterial PaCO2 >= 52 mm Hg)
criteria.description: Arterial blood gas (ABG) drawn while awake and breathing prescribed room air/oxygen documenting daytime PaCO2 >= 52 mm Hg.
criteria.clinical_intent: Objective arterial threshold for chronic ventilatory failure
criteria.cms_document: DME MAC LCD Respiratory Assist Devices

criteria.name: Prior CPAP Trial Failure or Severe Hypoventilation Syndrome
criteria.description: Documented failure of standard CPAP to resolve hypoxemia/hypercapnia, or underlying diagnosis of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) / thoracic restrictive disorder.
criteria.clinical_intent: Differentiate complex ventilatory insufficiency from simple OSA
criteria.cms_document: DME MAC LCD Respiratory Assist Devices

criteria.name: Simple Obstructive Sleep Apnea Without Hypoventilation Exclusion
criteria.description: Device requested for uncomplicated obstructive sleep apnea in the absence of hypercapnia (PaCO2 < 45) or daytime hypoventilation.
criteria.clinical_intent: Exclude BiPAP with backup for simple sleep apnea
criteria.cms_document: DME MAC LCD Respiratory Assist Devices
